newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chairman up stake in CITIC Pacific.
newsitem.headline: Chairman up stake in CITIC Pacific.

text.p: CITIC Pacific Ltd said on Monday chairman Larry Yung had lifted his interest in the company by 13.64 percent after a management team bought a 15.47 percent stake in the China-controlled conglomerate.

Bloomfield Enterprises Corp and Earnplex Corp, companies owned by Yung, reported holding 291 million shares or 13.64 percent of CITIC Pacific's issued share capital, CITIC Pacific said in a statement to the Hong Kong stock exchange.
Managing director Henry Fan lifted his interest in the company by 30 million shares, or 1.41 percent of CITIC Pacific's issued share capital, it said.
The statement did not say how many shares Yung and Fan now hold. The latest records, from the end of 1995, show Yung then held 92.58 million shares and Fan held 13 million.

CITIC Pacific earlier said a management team headed by Yung would buy a 15.47 percent stake, or 330 million shares, in the company for HK$33 a share from parent China International Trust & Investment Corp Hong Kong (Holdings) Ltd.
CITIC Hong Kong's interest would be lowered to 26.45 percent from about 41.92 percent, it said.
CITIC Pacific shares were up HK$1.90 to HK$45.50 at midday on Monday. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
